title: 04-profile-admin-desktop-en
prompt: Design the EMPLOYEE PROFILE — ADMIN VIEW, desktop 1440px wide. This is what a manager sees when opening an employee record, and it carries everything the staff view has plus the employment and permission controls staff never see. Reuse the source design's exact app shell with the People rail icon ACTIVE. A breadcrumb row reads 'People / Employees / Micah Lozon' in 13px #6B7280. PROFILE HEADER BAND: a white bordered rounded-xl panel holding an 80px avatar with colored-initial fallback 'ML', the name 'Micah Lozon' at 28px/600, a 13px #6B7280 line 'Employee #1045 · hired Mar 4, 2025', a chip row with an amber 'Server · L2' chip and a cyan 'Runner · L1' chip, a teal 'Active' status pill, and at the right a white bordered 'Message' button, a white bordered 'Archive employee' button and a primary #2563EB 'Save changes' button. In-page underline tabs: 'Details' ACTIVE, then 'Schedule', 'Punches', 'Documents' and 'Disciplinary' inactive, with a small amber '1' badge on Disciplinary. A TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT with a 24px gutter, left column about 58 percent and right about 42 percent. LEFT COLUMN, three stacked cards. Card A 'Personal information' with paired label-value rows in two columns: Legal name 'Micah Lozon', Preferred name 'Micah', Email 'micah.lozon@example.com', Phone '(305) 555-0142', Date of birth 'Nov 8, 1998', Address '1420 SW 8th St, Miami, FL 33135', each label 12px/500 #6B7280 above a 14px #1F2937 value. Card B 'Emergency contact' with rows for Name 'Rosa Lozon', Relationship 'Mother', Phone '(305) 555-0198'. Card C 'Employment' — the admin-only card: rows for Employment type showing a select with 'Hourly-tipped' and a 12px #6B7280 helper listing the other options; Hourly rate showing a currency input with '\$11.00' in tabular figures and a 12px #6B7280 'Last changed Jan 2, 2026 from \$10.50'; Overtime eligible with a toggle ON; Clock required with a toggle ON and a 12px #6B7280 helper 'Employee must punch in and out for every shift.'; Tips required with a toggle ON and a helper 'Employee must report tips at clock-out.'; Start date 'Mar 4, 2025'; Status showing a segmented Active / Archived control with Active selected. RIGHT COLUMN, four stacked cards. Card D 'Shift roles & skill levels' — the important admin editor. A heading with a small '+ Add role' ghost button, then two role rows, each a bordered rounded-lg block: the first shows an amber Server color dot with 'Server' in 14px/600, a 12px #6B7280 'Primary role' tag, and a LEVEL SELECTOR rendered as three selectable level pills L1, L2, L3 with L2 filled #2563EB and white, plus a small trash icon; the second shows a cyan Runner dot with 'Runner', and a level selector with L1 selected. Beneath them a 12px #6B7280 legend 'L1 trainee · L2 independent · L3 can train others'. Card E 'Permission overrides' — a heading with a 12px #6B7280 sub-line 'Overrides replace the default permissions for this employee's role.' Then three rows, each a permission name in 14px at the left, a 12px #6B7280 'Role default' value in the middle, and a three-state control at the right reading Inherit / Allow / Deny: 'View labor reports' with role default 'Deny' and the control on Inherit; 'Edit own punches' with role default 'Deny' and the control on ALLOW — highlight this row with a light #2563EB tint and a small 'Override' chip; 'Approve trades' with role default 'Deny' and the control on Inherit. A ghost '+ Add override' at the bottom. Card F 'Login methods' with three rows each showing a provider icon, a name and a status — 'Google' with a teal 'Linked' pill and the email beneath, 'Email & password' with a teal 'Linked' pill, and 'Phone OTP' at 45 percent opacity with a gray 'Coming soon' chip. Card G 'Scheduling notes' — a textarea containing the realistic note 'Prefers dinner shifts. Cannot work Thursday lunch (class). Training toward L3 — pair with Rebekah when possible.' with a 12px #6B7280 attribution 'Last updated by Daphne Jalil on Aug 2, 2026' and a 12px #6B7280 privacy line 'Visible to managers only.' Also include a small 'Language preference' control showing an EN/ES segmented toggle with EN active. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for selected levels, overrides and the primary action, teal #14B8A6 for linked and active. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 32-roles-and-hierarchy-desktop-en
prompt: Design the SETTINGS — ROLES & HIERARCHY screen, desktop 1440px wide. Reuse the source design's exact app shell with the Settings rail icon ACTIVE. A SETTINGS SUB-NAVIGATION sits between the icon rail and the content, about 220px wide, white with a 1px right border, holding a vertical list of settings sections where 'Roles & hierarchy' is ACTIVE with a white-on-blue selected treatment: General, Roles & hierarchy, Permissions, Time off, AI providers, Integrations, Billing. Page title 'Roles & hierarchy' 28/600 with a 13px #6B7280 sub-line 'Define shift roles, their order and which roles can cover each other', and at the right a primary #2563EB '+ New role' button. SKILL LEVEL LEGEND at the top: a bordered rounded-xl strip with a 13px/600 heading 'Skill levels' and three inline definitions each with a small level pill and a description — 'L1' with 'Trainee — cannot work alone or take covers', 'L2' with 'Independent — standard scheduling', 'L3' with 'Can train others and cover any lower level'. THE ROLE LIST, the centerpiece: a white bordered rounded-xl panel with a header row in 12px/600 uppercase letter-spaced #6B7280 reading Order, Role, Department, Employees, Can cover, and a trailing actions column. Each role row is 64px with a 1px bottom border and begins with a six-dot DRAG HANDLE in #6B7280 to signal reorderable rows, followed by the role color dot and the role name in 14px/600, the department as a chip, an employee count, a compact summary of coverable roles, a kebab, and a caret to expand. Populate rows in hierarchy order with their exact colors: Manager/MOD #EC4899, FOH, 3 employees; Shift Supervisor #22C55E, FOH, 2; Bartender #8B5CF6, FOH, 2 — this row is EXPANDED; Server #F5A623, FOH, 7; On Call Server #64748B, FOH, 2; Host #F97316, FOH, 2; Barista #A16207, FOH, 1; Runner #06B6D4, FOH, 1; Expo #14B8A6, BOH, 1; Kitchen Lead in warm earth #B45309, BOH, 1; Hot Line Cook #B45309, BOH, 2; Cold Line Cook #92400E, BOH, 2; Prep Cook #78716C, BOH, 1; Dishwasher #57534E, BOH, 1. THE EXPANDED BARTENDER ROW is the important detail: beneath the Bartender row, an inset panel with a light #F8F8F7 fill and a 2px purple left accent, headed 'Can cover' in 13px/600 with a 12px #6B7280 explainer 'A Bartender may be scheduled into or take covers for these roles, subject to skill level.' Inside, a grid of CHECKBOX ROWS listing every other role, each with a checkbox, the role color dot and the role name: CHECKED are Server, Host and Runner; UNCHECKED are Manager/MOD, Shift Supervisor, On Call Server, Barista, Expo, Kitchen Lead, Hot Line Cook, Cold Line Cook, Prep Cook and Dishwasher. Render the checked rows with a light teal tint so the covered set reads instantly. Beneath the checkboxes a MINIMUM LEVEL control: a 13px/600 label 'Minimum skill level to cover' with a three-pill L1 / L2 / L3 selector with L2 selected, and a 12px #6B7280 helper 'A Bartender must be at least L2 to pick up a Server shift.' The inset panel ends with a ghost 'Cancel' and a small primary 'Save coverage' button. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, the exact role band colors listed, #2563EB for selection and primary actions, teal #14B8A6 for checked coverage. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 33-permissions-matrix-desktop-en
prompt: Design the SETTINGS — PERMISSIONS MATRIX screen, desktop 1440px wide, with the per-person override drawer open. Reuse the source design's exact app shell with the Settings rail icon ACTIVE and the same 220px settings sub-navigation, with 'Permissions' ACTIVE. Page title 'Permissions' 28/600 with a 13px #6B7280 sub-line 'Set what each role can do. Individual employees can be overridden.', and at the right a white bordered 'Reset to defaults' button and a primary #2563EB 'Save changes' button. A 12px #6B7280 note strip: 'Owners always have every permission and cannot be restricted.' THE MATRIX, the centerpiece: a white bordered rounded-xl panel. Its header row has a wide left column headed 'Permission' and FIVE role columns headed with the role name in 12px/600 above a 11px #6B7280 employee count — 'Owner 2', 'GM 1', 'Manager 1', 'Assistant Mgr 2', 'Supervisor 2'. Permission rows are grouped under small 11px/600 uppercase letter-spaced #6B7280 group headers with a subtle #F8F8F7 fill. Each permission row is 52px with a 1px bottom border, the permission name in 14px #1F2937 at the left with a 12px #6B7280 key beneath in a monospace-like treatment, and five TOGGLE CELLS centered in their columns. Toggles that are ON are #2563EB filled; OFF are gray. The Owner column's toggles are all ON and rendered at 55 percent opacity with a small lock icon to show they cannot be changed. Populate these groups and rows. Group SCHEDULING: 'Publish schedule' key schedule.publish with Owner on, GM on, Manager on, Assistant off, Supervisor off; 'Edit any shift' key schedule.edit with on, on, on, on, off; 'Generate AI draft' key schedule.ai with on, on, on, off, off; 'Approve trades' key trade.approve with on, on, on, on, on. Group TIME & PAY: 'View punches' key punch.view with on, on, on, on, on; 'Edit punches' key punch.edit with on, on, on, on, off; 'Add manual punch' key punch.manual with on, on, on, on, on; 'View labor reports' key report.labor with on, on, on, off, off; 'Run payroll' key payroll.run with on, on, off, off, off; 'Lock pay period' key payroll.lock with on, on, off, off, off. Group PEOPLE & HR: 'Add employee' key people.create with on, on, on, off, off; 'Edit pay rate' key people.rate with on, on, off, off, off; 'Issue disciplinary action' key hr.discipline with on, on, on, on, off; 'Publish policy' key hr.policy with on, on, off, off, off. Group SETTINGS: 'Manage roles' key settings.roles with on, on, off, off, off; 'Manage AI providers' key settings.ai with on, off, off, off, off. THE OVERRIDE DRAWER, open on the right side, about 400px wide, white with a 1px left border and a soft leftward shadow, running full height. Its header holds a 32px avatar, 'Armando Hernandez' in 16px/600, a 12px #6B7280 'Assistant Manager · Employee #1038' and a close ×. A 13px #6B7280 explainer 'Overrides apply to this person only and replace their role default.' Then a list of permission rows mirroring the matrix keys, each with the permission name, a 12px #6B7280 'Role default: On' or 'Off' line, and a three-state Inherit / Allow / Deny segmented control. Most rows sit on Inherit. TWO ROWS ARE OVERRIDDEN and must be visually obvious: 'View labor reports' with role default Off and the control on ALLOW, and 'Run payroll' with role default Off and the control on ALLOW — give both rows a light #2563EB tint, a 2px #2563EB left accent and a small 'Override' chip. Beneath the list a bordered strip with 12px #6B7280 text '2 overrides active · last changed by Rafa on Aug 4, 2026', and a drawer footer with a ghost 'Clear all overrides' in #EF4444 and a primary #2563EB 'Save overrides'. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for enabled toggles and overrides. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients beyond the drawer shadow, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 34-ai-providers-desktop-en

Page title 'AI providers' 28/600 with a 13px #6B7280 sub-line 'Choose the model that generates schedule drafts', and at the right a white bordered 'Test connection' button and a primary #2563EB 'Save changes' button. A SECURITY NOTE strip at the top: a bordered rounded-xl row with a small shield icon and 13px #6B7280 text 'API keys are encrypted at rest and never sent to the browser. Only owners can view or change them.' FOUR PROVIDER CARDS in a two-by-two grid with a 24px gutter, each a white bordered rounded-xl card with 24px padding. Each card has a header row holding a 40px rounded-lg provider logo tile rendered as a simple flat monogram block, the provider name in 16px/600, a 12px #6B7280 descriptor, and an ACTIVE RADIO at the top right — a radio control with the label 'Active'. Each card body has: a 'Model' select with a caret; an 'API key' masked input showing a key icon and the value as a row of bullet characters followed by the last four characters, with a small ghost 'Replace' link; and a footer status line. CARD 1 — ANTHROPIC, the SELECTED provider: give this card a 2px #2563EB border and a very light #2563EB tint, and its radio is FILLED with the label 'Active'. Descriptor 'Claude models'. The Model select shows 'Claude Opus 5' with a 12px #6B7280 line beneath reading 'claude-opus-5' and a note that the dropdown also offers Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Haiku 4.5. The API key field shows masked bullets ending in '4F2A'. Footer status: a teal check with 13px 'Connected · last used Aug 13, 2026 at 9:04 AM'. CARD 2 — OPENAI: unselected, plain 1px border, empty radio. Descriptor 'GPT models'. Model select showing a GPT model name, API key masked ending in '9B71', footer a teal check with 'Connected · not in use'. CARD 3 — GOOGLE: unselected. Descriptor 'Gemini models'. Model select showing a Gemini model name, API key field EMPTY with the placeholder 'Paste your API key', and a footer with a #6B7280 dash icon and 13px 'Not configured'. CARD 4 — CUSTOM: unselected. Descriptor 'Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint'. This card has an extra 'Base URL' input above the model field showing 'https://api.example.com/v1', a free-text Model input showing a placeholder, an empty API key field, and a footer with a #6B7280 dash and 'Not configured'. Beneath the grid a USAGE CARD: a white bordered rounded-xl panel headed 'Usage this month' 16px/600 with three inline stat blocks in tabular figures — 'Schedule drafts generated 12', 'Tokens used 1.84M', 'Estimated cost \$14.20' — and a 12px #6B7280 line 'Billed directly by your provider. Rosalia's Kitchen Staff Hub does not resell model access.' Beneath it a FALLBACK ROW: a bordered strip with a 13px/600 label 'If the active provider fails' and a select showing 'Show an error and keep the manual builder' with a 12px #6B7280 helper 'AI drafts never publish automatically, so a failure never affects a live schedule.' Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for the active provider and primary actions, teal #14B8A6 for connected status. title: 35-general-settings-desktop-en
prompt: Design the SETTINGS — GENERAL screen, desktop 1440px wide. Reuse the source design's exact app shell with the Settings rail icon ACTIVE and the same 220px settings sub-navigation, with 'General' ACTIVE. Page title 'General' 28/600 with a 13px #6B7280 sub-line 'Location, deadlines, pay period and feature flags', and at the right a primary #2563EB 'Save changes' button. A TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT with a 24px gutter, left about 55 percent and right about 45 percent. LEFT COLUMN. Card A 'Restaurant' — rows for Name showing an input with 'Rosalia's Kitchen', Address with '1802 SW 22nd St, Miami, FL 33145', Time zone with a select showing 'America/New_York (EDT)', and a Logo row showing a 48px deep-red #B4232A logo tile with a ghost 'Replace' link. Card B 'GEOFENCE' — the visual centerpiece of this screen. A heading 'Punch geofence' 16px/600 with a 12px #6B7280 sub-line 'Employees must be inside this radius to clock in or out.' Beneath it a MAP CARD: a bordered rounded-xl block containing a schematic flat line-art map — a light #F8F8F7 ground, a few thin #E5E7EB street lines, and centered a soft teal-tinted filled CIRCLE with a 2px #14B8A6 dashed outline representing the allowed radius, with a small teal pin at its center labeled 'Rosalia's Kitchen' in 11px. Keep it schematic, never a photographic map. Beneath the map a RADIUS SLIDER: a 13px/500 label 'Radius' with the value '150 m' at the right in 14px/600 tabular figures, a horizontal slider track in #E5E7EB with the filled portion in #2563EB and a 20px round handle positioned about a third along, and tick labels beneath at 50 m, 150 m, 300 m and 500 m in 11px #6B7280. A 12px #6B7280 helper 'A larger radius reduces false blocks but weakens verification.' Then a toggle row 'Allow manager override when blocked' in the ON state. Card C 'Pay period' — rows for Frequency showing a select with 'Biweekly', Period start showing a date input with 'Monday', Current period showing a read-only strip 'Aug 3 – Aug 16, 2026' with an amber 'In review' pill, Overtime threshold showing '40 hrs / week' in tabular figures, and Overtime multiplier showing '1.5×'. RIGHT COLUMN. Card D 'Deadlines' — a heading with a 12px #6B7280 sub-line 'Weekly cutoffs that drive reminders.' Two prominent deadline rows, each a bordered rounded-lg block with an icon, a 14px/600 label, a day select and a time input in tabular figures, plus a 12px #6B7280 helper: 'Availability submission' set to 'Thursday' at '11:59 PM' with the helper 'Staff are reminded 24 hours before.'; 'Schedule publish' set to 'Friday' at '11:59 PM' with the helper 'Managers are reminded if the next week is still a draft.' Beneath them a toggle row 'Send reminder notifications' ON. Card E 'Feature flags' — a heading with a 12px #6B7280 sub-line 'Turn features on as they become available.' Four rows, each with a 14px/600 name, a 12px #6B7280 description, and a toggle at the right: 'Phone OTP sign-in' with 'Let staff sign in with a texted code' and a toggle OFF plus a small gray 'Coming soon' chip; 'Payroll integration' with 'Push approved periods to Gusto or ADP' and a toggle OFF plus a 'Coming soon' chip; 'AI schedule drafts' with 'Generate a draft week from availability and forecast' and a toggle ON; 'Photo proof on tasks' with 'Require a photo to complete flagged tasks' and a toggle ON. Card F 'Danger zone' — a bordered card with a 1px #EF4444 border, headed 'Danger zone' 15px/600 in #EF4444, containing one row with a 14px/600 'Reset all settings to defaults', a 12px #6B7280 'This cannot be undone.' and a white bordered button whose text is #EF4444 reading 'Reset settings'. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for the slider fill and primary actions, teal #14B8A6 for the geofence circle, amber #F59E0B for the in-review pill, red #EF4444 confined to the danger zone. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color — it appears only in the logo tile. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 36-time-off-desktop-en
prompt: Design the SETTINGS — TIME OFF screen, desktop 1440px wide, showing both the requests list and the month calendar, mirroring how 7shifts lays this out. Reuse the source design's exact app shell with the Settings rail icon ACTIVE and the same 220px settings sub-navigation, with 'Time off' ACTIVE. Page title 'Time off' 28/600 with a 13px #6B7280 sub-line 'Review requests and see coverage across the month', and at the right a white bordered 'Export' button and a primary #2563EB '+ Add time off' button. In-page underline tabs: 'Requests' ACTIVE and 'Calendar' inactive — but render BOTH views on this frame, the requests list first and the calendar beneath it, so the whole surface is visible at once. FILTER ROW: an employee select showing 'All employees', a date-range control showing 'August 2026', a category select showing 'All categories', a status select showing 'All statuses', and a search input. SUMMARY STRIP: four bordered stat tiles in tabular figures — 'Pending 3', 'Approved this month 6', 'Declined 1', 'Days off requested 14'. THE REQUESTS TABLE, white bordered rounded-xl, header row in 12px/600 uppercase letter-spaced #6B7280 with columns Employee, Dates, Category, Hours remaining, Conflict, Status, and a trailing actions column. Rows are 64px with 1px bottom borders. The STATUS cell is a compact dropdown control, not a static pill — render it as a small select showing the current status with a caret so it reads as changeable inline. Populate seven realistic rows: Daniela Zaragoza with a 28px avatar and a 12px #6B7280 'Host · L2', dates 'Thu Aug 13 – Fri Aug 14' with a 12px #6B7280 '2 days', category an 'Unpaid' gray chip, hours remaining '0.0 hrs' in #6B7280, a conflict cell holding an amber warning triangle with a 12px #6B7280 'Scheduled Aug 13', a Pending status dropdown, and an inline teal 'Approve' and white bordered 'Decline' pair; Robin Leyva 'Assistant Manager', 'Sat Aug 15 – Sun Aug 16', '2 days', a 'Paid' teal chip, '24.0 hrs', no conflict shown as a small #6B7280 dash, an Approved status dropdown, kebab only; Micah Lozon 'Server · L2', 'Mon Aug 24 – Wed Aug 26', '3 days', 'Unpaid', '0.0 hrs', no conflict, a Pending dropdown with the approve and decline pair; Isaac Boynton 'Bartender · L3', 'Fri Aug 28', '1 day', 'Paid', '16.0 hrs', an amber conflict triangle with 'Scheduled Aug 28', a Pending dropdown with the pair; Emily Roman 'Server · L1', 'Mon Aug 3 – Tue Aug 4', '2 days', 'Unpaid', '0.0 hrs', no conflict, an Approved dropdown; Karla Ceballos 'Server · L1', 'Sat Aug 8', '1 day', 'Unpaid', '0.0 hrs', no conflict, a Declined dropdown with a 12px #6B7280 reason 'Saturday coverage'; Anthony 'Runner · L1', 'Mon Aug 31', '1 day', 'Paid', '8.0 hrs', no conflict, an Approved dropdown. THE MONTH CALENDAR beneath the table: a white bordered rounded-xl panel headed 'August 2026' 18/600 with month chevrons and a 'Today' ghost button. A seven-column grid with weekday headers Mon through Sun in 11px/600 uppercase #6B7280, and day cells about 110px tall with 1px #E5E7EB gridlines, the date number at the top-left of each cell in 13px/600 tabular figures. Days outside August are at 40 percent opacity. Inside the cells, render TIME-OFF BARS as employee-colored rounded-full bars spanning their date range across cells, each carrying a 24px avatar at its left and the employee's first name in 11px/600 — bars are tinted with the employee's role color at about 20 percent opacity with a full-strength left cap, and PENDING bars are drawn with a dashed 1px outline while APPROVED bars are solid. Place the bars to match the table: a dashed Daniela bar spanning Aug 13 to 14; a solid Robin bar spanning Aug 15 to 16; a dashed Micah bar spanning Aug 24 to 26; a dashed Isaac bar on Aug 28; a solid Emily bar spanning Aug 3 to 4; a solid Anthony bar on Aug 31. Put a small red dot in the corner of Aug 13 and Aug 28 to mark the conflict days, and give the current day Aug 13 a 2px #2563EB ring. Add a small legend beneath the calendar with 'Solid = approved', 'Dashed = pending' and a red dot for 'Scheduling conflict'. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, teal #14B8A6 for approved and paid, amber #F59E0B for pending and conflicts, red #EF4444 for declined and conflict dots, #2563EB for primary actions. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.
